proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.vs_spells
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive benefit needs to apply only to saving throws caused by spells, not all saving throws.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

proposed_widenings.name: automatic_post_save_spell_negation
proposed_widenings.justification: The item automatically cancels a qualifying triggering spell on the wearer after a successful save, with no action or reaction cost.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you.

proposed_widenings.name: reflect_triggering_spell_to_caster
proposed_widenings.justification: The optional rider must retarget the triggering spell back at its caster and resolve that spell against the caster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.

notes: No content file was authored. Existing magic-item families cannot represent the automatic post-save interrupt honestly, and the reflection rider also lacks a triggering-spell replay surface.
